interpretive_boundaries: The figure is an author synthesis of repository contracts and local engineering evidence; it reports no empirical performance or user outcome.

A content or derivation hash supports integrity, stable identity and lineage. It does not establish publisher correctness, source completeness, encryption, anonymisation, lawful authority, ethics approval or production fitness.
The canonical Report/Claim path and CompanyResearchSource/CompanyResearchClaim/ProfileVersion path are separate persisted models; the figure does not imply an unimplemented automatic merge.
The guarded company-research path has fake, synthetic and adversarial engineering evidence but no completed live public-company capture or external-model result.
The domain-approved catalogue freeze, D1/D2 reference construction, and C0/C3 participant or reviewer observations remain protocol-only and unpopulated.
SQLite and ignored local files are the implemented persistence boundary. No external database, managed object store, cloud deployment, multi-user concurrency or production guarantee is represented.
